[shares a photo holding a videogame controller]

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: It was an amazing experience! I'll never forget seeing all of the characters and dialogue I wrote being acted out - it was such a cool feeling. Having all the hard work and determination I put into writing pay off was definitely rewarding. I know this is the third time it's happened, but its just so awesome!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: That must have been amazing. What was your favorite part of it?

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Seeing my characters I worked so hard on come alive was my favorite part. It felt like they jumped off the page and became real - it was totally surreal.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Wow Joanna, those drawings are really incredible! What inspired you to create them?

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Thanks, Nate! They're visuals of the characters to help bring them alive in my head so I can write better.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: That's a cool way to gain insight into your characters. Where did you get your ideas for them?

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: I got ideas from everywhere: people I know, stuff I saw, even what I imagined. It's cool to see how an idea takes shape into a person with their own wants, worries, and wishes.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Wow Joanna, that's so cool! It's amazing how our imaginations can bring ideas to life. Can you tell me more about the character on the left in the photo?

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Nope! You'll just have to watch the movie and find out for yourself!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: You got it. I was already planning on watching it, but talking to you about it makes me want to watch it even more!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Awesome! Well enough about me, what have you been up to?

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: I was bored today, so I just took my turtles out for a walk.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Sound fun! Did they have a good time?

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Of course! They look tired from all the walking, so they're relaxing in the tank right now.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Aww, they're so cute! What do they eat?

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: They eat a combination of vegetables, fruits, and insects. They have a varied diet.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Wow, that's fascinating! It's interesting how they have such a varied diet, including insects. Do you have a favorite among their food choices?

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: I love seeing them eat fruit - they get so hyped and it's so cute!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Wow, that's so cute! They look like they really enjoy fruit.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Yeah, it's adorable! Watching them enjoy their favorite snacks is so fun. I also like holding them.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Do they have different personalities, like the way dogs and cats do?

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Yeah, they each do. One is more adventurous while the other is more reserved, which I find cute. Having them around brings me joy and they make great companions.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: That's super cool! I never knew turtles could be so interesting until I met your turtles. Wow!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: I've always liked turtles since I was a boy, so I know all about them!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: You'll have to keep me posted on them! It's been fun chatting!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: See you later Joanna!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Wow, Nate, I'm on fire! I just set up meetings with movie producers — my dreams are comin' true!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Wow Joanna, nice work! How did it go with those producer meetings?

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Thanks, Nate! The meetings went really well. I felt confident discussing my script and vision and they seemed interested and excited. They loved the elements of self-discovery in it. It was so validating to be taken seriously. I'm feeling hopeful and inspired about the future!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Way to go, Joanna! Putting yourself out there is really brave and winning recognition for your hard work feels great. It's just like when I win a video game tournament - it feels awesome! I'm so proud of you and so glad you're feeling hopeful and inspired.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Thanks Nate! Your support and encouragement mean a lot. Writing isn't always easy but moments like these make me appreciate it. I'm so thankful for all the opportunities. Last week, I found these old notebooks with my early writings - it was cool to see how far I've come.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: That's cool! You must love seeing how you've grown as an artist. Is there a favorite piece from your early writings that stands out to you?

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Yup, I still remember this story from when I was 10. It was about a brave little turtle who was scared but explored the world anyway. Maybe even back then, I was inspired by stories about finding courage and taking risks. It's still a part of my writing today.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: You obviously have a passion for writing, and it's funny the story was about a turtle! Their resilience is so inspiring! Take courage and keep pushing yourself with your writing. Great job!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Thanks, Nate! They make me think of strength and perseverance. They help motivate me in tough times - glad you find that inspiring!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: What can I say, I love turtles. So, what's been happening with you?

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Hey Nate! Apart from meetings, I'm working on a project - challenging but fulfilling. How about you? What's been going on?

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Just been helping some friends reset their high scores at the international tournament. It's been fun!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Wow, sounds like so much fun! You're really passionate about gaming. Have an awesome time and keep helping others with those high scores!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Thanks! It feels good to use my skills to make a difference.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: I couldn't agree more! Which is why my meetings are so exciting!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: On another note, want to come over and try some of this? It's super yummy, just made it yesterday!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Mmm, that looks delicious! Is it lactose-free by any chance?

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Yep, I made it with coconut milk so it's lactose-free!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Thanks so much, Nate! Sure! I'll come over tomorrow if that's fine.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: I don't see why not! I'm not doing anything then, so your completely welcome to!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Awesome! I'll bring some of my recipes so we can both share deserts!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: I'd love that! I've been wanting to try some of your chocolate and rasberry cake for a while now.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: You got it! See you tomorrow!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: See you then! Take care!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Hey Joanna! Hope you’re doing alright. Crazy thing happened - I was in the final of a big Valorant tournament last Saturday, and I won! It was the best feeling to see my name as the champion. Tournaments really bring out strong emotions in me.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Hey Nate! Congrats on winning the tournament - that's awesome! I know you must have been buzzing! Anyway, I've been working on something exciting too. Last Friday, I finished the presentation for producers - it was tough but it's looking good. What have you been up to?

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Thanks, Joanna! I've been having a blast and preparing for other tournaments, so I've been real busy - but I'm loving it!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Sounds like you're really loving life right now! It's great when you find something that suits you. Being busy can be tiring but it's so rewarding in the end. Keep it up!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Thanks, Joanna! I'm really grateful to have a job I enjoy every day. So anyways, anything new going on in your life?

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: I am writing another movie script! It's a love story with lots of challenges. I've put lots of hard work into it and I'm hoping to get it on the big screen.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Woah Joanna, that's incredible! I remember when you started working on these sorta things. It's crazy to see how far you've gotten! You've really got a thing for writing, huh? Where'd you get the idea for it?

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Thanks Nate! Writing has always been a passion of mine. I got the idea for this script from a dream. How have your turtles been? I haven't seen pictures of them in a while!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Great actually! These little guys sure bring joy to my life! Watching them is so calming and fascinating. I've really grown fond of them. So, what about you, Joanna? What brings you happiness?

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Creating stories and watching them come alive gives me happiness and fulfillment. Writing has been such a blessing for me.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Well with dedication like yours, its no wonder you do so well in it as well! Are you planning on submitting anymore scripts anytime soon?

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Yep! I actually just submitted a few more last week! Hoping to hear back from them soon, though I assume a few will be rejected.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Even if it happens to a few, I'm sure at leasts one will make it to the screens and be your 3rd published movie!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Thanks, Nate! Appreciate the encouragement. I won't give up, I promise! Got it covered!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Great to hear! On another note, I just upgraded some of my equipment at home. Check it out!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Oh wow, ice set-up! Do you use that computer for gaming?

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Yep! This is where I practice and compete. Sometimes I even use it when I'm playing games with friends.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Cool! Having a dedicated space for practice and competition should help you stay focused.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Yeah, I love it. It's like my own little haven to escape into the virtual world.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Wow, that sounds great to have your own gaming setup at home. It must be really awesome!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: It really is! But it's also really important to have something like this for my career, otherwise I would never be able to beat my competition.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: That makes sense! It's all about practice isn't it? So what's your favorite game?

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Yep! I'm currently playing this awesome fantasy RPG called "Xeonoblade Chronicles" and it's been a blast! I highly reccomend it if you've never played it before.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: What made you start playing it? That's a japanese game series right?

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Yes it is! I'm a big fan of Nintendo games, and I've actually been wanting to play this one for a while because my friends have played it and reccomended it!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Nice! It's really cool when a reccomendation from a friend fits your taste so well isn't it?

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: For sure! That's why I love when you give me movie reccomendations, I usually like them a lot more then if I were to just watch some random one.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Great to hear! I just finished with the intro to my next movie script, and I decided to include this at the begining.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: That letter is really awesome! Does it remind you of your childhood?

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Yeah, it does! My brother wrote it - he used to make me these cute notes when we were kids. Brings back sweet memories.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Aww, childhood memories can be so powerful!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: They sure can! They take us back to simpler times but it's nice to create new memories as we grow up.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Totally! I had a special day when I took my pets to the park. They were amazed and seeing their happy faces made it a memorable day. Mixing the new with the old is priceless - I treasure every memory!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: That sounds so sweet, Nate! I started writing some of my favorite memories down.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Dang, your full of great ideas Joanna! I really should start doing that as well, or at least write down the things my animals like a lot!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: You should! I completely encourage it, looking back on fond memories is such a blessing.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Ok I will! But I'll also start writing down some of my favorite memories with you from now on.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Definitely, let's keep making great memories and supporting each other. Let's keep reaching for our dreams and make them happen!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Hey Joanna, what a wild week! My game tournament got pushed back, so I tried out some cooking. Look at this homemade coconut ice cream! The sprinkles kinda changed the color this time around.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Hey Nate, that looks yummy! Wish I could try it, but I can't right now. How did the last game tournament go?

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Hey Joanna, thanks! Tough tournament, didn't make it to the finals. But that's okay, I'll get 'em next time!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Aww, bummer! But the important thing is to stay positive. So, what's your next move in the gaming world?

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Thanks Joanna! Staying positive is key. I'm thinking of joining a new gaming team after this next tourney - I've had a few offers, but I haven't decided yet. It's gonna be a big step, but I'm ready for a shake up.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Sounds great, Nate! Making a switch could open up new opportunities. Wishing you luck with picking the right team!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Thanks, Joanna! I really appreciate it. It's a big decision, but I'm excited for what the future holds. How about you? Anything exciting happening on your end?

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Yup! I worked hard on another script and eventually created a plan for getting it made into a movie. It was a ton of work but satisfying. I pitched it to some producers yesterday and they really liked it. It gave me a big confidence boost!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Congrats on the chance to pitch your script - super impressive. Proud of you!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Appreciate you, Nate! Your support and encouragement mean a lot to me. I feel like I just can't stop writing write now!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Anytime. What're you working on in that notebook? Anything cool?

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Hey Nate, I'm working on a new project - a suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town. It's been a great creative outlet for me. How about you? Do you have any projects you're working on?

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Yeah actually - creating gaming content for YouTube. It's a cool way to entertain folks and satisfy my video game cravings at the same time when there aren't any tourneys going on.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Wow, that's a cool idea! What inspired you to start making gaming videos?

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Hey Joanna, I'm a big fan of them and thought it would be a fun idea to start making them myself. I'm hoping to share my love of gaming and connect with others who enjoy it too.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Way to go, Nate! Making videos and connecting with people about gaming - that's awesome! You'll do great!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Thanks Joanna! Appreciate the support. It's new to me but I'm excited to get started!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Make sure you watch other peoples videos first so you get a handle on what your audience likes! That way your videos don't flop when you post them.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Already doing that, but thanks for the advice!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: No worries, Nate! It's great to support each other in reaching our goals. On another note, check out this pic I got a while back!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Wow, that sunset pic looks incredible! What inspired you to take that photo?

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Thanks, Nate! I took that pic on a hike last summer near Fort Wayne. The sunset and the surrounding beauty were just incredible. It was an awesome reminder of nature's beauty.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: That sounds incredible! Nature truly has a way of reminding us to appreciate the beauty around us, and moments like those really stay with you. These critters also make me appreciate life's little joys. And guess what? I got them a new friend!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Wow, what made you get a third?

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Turtles really bring me joy and peace. They have such an effect on us - best buddies ever! I saw another at a pet store and just hade to get him. The tank is big enough now for three, so I figured why not!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Wow! It's always a shock where life will take us next! I bet just last week you would have never thought you would be getting a third turtle this year!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: You got that right, but I'm very happy with the descision and wouldn't have it any other way.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Can I come over sometime and watch you play with them? From a distance I mean, since I'm allergic.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Definitely! I'd love to have you over again. Maybe we can watch one of your movies together or go to the park!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: For sure! I'd love to do either of those things with you!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Sounds good. Well I'll make sure I give the turtles a bath before you get here so they're ready to play.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Alright, see you tomorrow!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Bye Joanna!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Nate, can you believe it? I'm finally filming my own movie from the road-trip script!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Congrats, Joanna! Not surprised at all that your hard work paid off. Must feel awesome to see your script come alive in a movie! Pretty cool when something you love brings success, right? Tell me more about your movie!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Woohoo, thanks Nate! It's pretty wild to see it come alive. Every day on set is awesome and full of potential. Being able to show my vision is awesome.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: I think so too! What's been the coolest moment on set?

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: One of the actors came up to me and told me how much she liked my script! I was so excited when that happened - it gave me chills!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Wow Joanna, that must have been so exciting! It's incredible when you get those moments of joy. Anyway, I took my turtles to the beach in Tampa yesterday! They always bring me peace in the craziness of life.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Woah, that's awesome, Nate! You must really enjoy having them around - they're so cool! What do you love most about having them?

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Your completely right! I really love having them around. They're so cool and they make me feel calm. Plus, they don't require much looking after, which is great. I love seeing them soaking in the sun like this.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: That's awesome, Nate! They look so serene and happy. It's great to have something like that.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Yeah, turtles are like zen masters! They always remind me to slow down and appreciate the small things in life. I'm loving experimenting with flavors right now. Here are some colorful bowls of coconut milk ice cream that I made.

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Hey Nate, that looks really yummy! The colors and mix-ins give it a nice kick.

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: Nice! I'm glad you like it too. This recipe really jazzes it up. Wanna give it a try?

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Definitely, Nate! That ice cream looks mouthwatering. Thanks so much for offering!

source_turns.speaker: Nate
source_turns.text: No worries, Joanna. Hope you enjoy it!

source_turns.speaker: Joanna
source_turns.text: Yea, no worries! It was great catching up. Take it easy!
